high_level_description: The image appears to be a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "ashleshathaakur," who posted it 5 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The post features a quote on a beige background with a subtle texture that resembles paper or parchment. The quote is attributed to Thich Nhat Hanh and reads: "the water, the air, mother earth, the stars, the moon - they are all there for you. you can train yourself to breathe, walk, and sit in such a way that you can get connected with the stars, the trees, the air, the sunshine."
